description: The plot illustrates the relationship between the percent sequence ratio and two variables: perplexity and GPU memory ratio. The x-axis represents the percent sequence ratio, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 100%, marked at intervals of 20%. The left y-axis represents perplexity, with a linear scale ranging from 4.2 to 4.7, marked at intervals of 0.1. The right y-axis represents the GPU memory ratio, with a linear scale ranging from 40 to 90%, marked at intervals of 10%. The plot contains four lines: perplexity (orange, solid, circle markers), full cache PPL (red, dashed), GPU memory ratio (blue, solid, square markers), and full cache GPU memory (blue, dashed). The perplexity line starts at approximately 4.65 at 0% sequence ratio, decreases to around 4.38 at 40% sequence ratio, and then increases to about 4.45 at 100% sequence ratio. The full cache PPL line remains relatively constant at around 4.4 across the x-axis. The GPU memory ratio line starts at approximately 42% at 0% sequence ratio and increases to around 95% at 60% sequence ratio, before dropping to about 60% at 100% sequence ratio. The full cache GPU memory line remains relatively constant at around 58% across the x-axis.
